outcome: Full stomachs as assessed by gastric ultrasound
cohort: Participants were 140 non-labouring singleton pregnant women aged ≥18 years and ≥37 weeks gestational age, scheduled for elective caesarean section.
finding: Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD) during pregnancy was identified as an independent risk factor for full stomachs in patients scheduled for elective caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Immediately prior to anaesthesia for elective caesarean section
